issues.detail: The Greek 'ου μη νιψης' is a double negative (ou + mē), which in this context functions as a question: 'Why do you not wash my feet?' The Vietnamese translation renders it as a declarative statement: 'Chúa sẽ không bao giờ rửa chân tôi!' (Lord will never wash my feet!).

The Greek 'ου μη νιψης' is a 2nd person singular verb ('why do you not wash'). The Vietnamese translation uses a 3rd person future construction ('sẽ không bao giờ'), changing the subject and the nature of the interaction.
